other_conditions: Principal Inventor of an ongoing research grant or an extramural grant completed in the last three years, where the PI holds or has applied for a patent
Applicants (Principal Investigator and/or Co‑Inventors) must be Indian citizens; foreign nationals (including OCI and NRI) are also eligible if they meet SERB‑specified criteria

Applicant must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized academic institution, national laboratory, or other recognized R&D institution in India with at least three years of service remaining

Eligible host institutions include private academic institutions with UGC/AICTE/PCI approval, private R&D institutions with DSIR‑SIRO recognition, and NGOs registered under the NITI‑AAYOG Darpan portal
Principal Investigator and Co‑Investigators must possess a Ph.D. degree in Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or an M.D./M.S./M.D.S./M.V.Sc degree at the time of application
An applicant may submit only one proposal per call (as PI or Co‑PI) and may have no more than one active project as Principal Inventor under the TETRA programme
Proposals must be original; plagiarism is not acceptable and will lead to rejection
benefits_summary: Award up to ₹15 lakhs per year (excluding international travel) with overhead.
